scope: Available accepted source AC/TC and required supplemental executable scenarios. Design schemas/mappings are dependencies, not executable cases. Missing historical originals remain recorded. No business execution.

summary.count_unit: target-to-source acceptance assignments; shared native cases appear under every responsible target and must not be summed as unique business tests

kind_policy.ORIGINAL_AC: Literal original AC/TC identities; paired aliases are one assertion where the source states so.
kind_policy.REQUIRED_SUPPLEMENTAL_SCENARIO: Mandatory executable fixture/recovery/continuous assertion from accepted source. Internal registry IDs do not create a native AC identity.
kind_policy.design_dependencies: Schemas, tables, mappings and pure examples retained outside the executable denominator.

completion_policy: Every listed original and required supplement participates in the target DONE gate through roadmap.json. Attached refinements/preconditions and the complete scenario sequence belong to that case. Empty runtime evidence is NOT_RUN. Original catalog COMPLETE describes inventory only.

sources.normalization: D:/CP6/docs paths become repository-relative archive locators; missing case kind in original explicit-AC lists becomes ORIGINAL_AC. No runtime state changed.
